title: SB 568 (2025-2026 Regular Session (filed 2026, second year)): Elections and Primaries; the list of eligible voters is posted and made public (Composite Status). Long title begins: "To amend Chapter 2 of Title 21 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to elections and primaries generally, so as to require that the list of eligible voters is posted and made public prior to each primary or election;"
